dialogues.speaker: Flamehead Fan's Formula
dialogues.text: "Onions, mushrooms, ginger, garlic, soybeans, lettuce, wild boar meat, pepper, salt... Amounts... as we can spare them..."

dialogues.speaker: Flamehead Fan's Formula
dialogues.text: "...And use some Wolfhooks, Valberries, Clitopho's whole stock, use it all! And maybe some of those weird mushrooms we got from down there... and whatever else that's got taste..."

dialogues.speaker: Flamehead Fan's Formula
dialogues.text: "...Make sure the bones have been picked clean, and don't leave any bits that might get caught on the teeth while we're eating the meat!"
